front.title: Bounded Prior-Art Review and Transparent Scope Claims in Internet-Drafts

abstract.t: Technical standards work benefits from extensive reading, comparison, and revision. However, examining many documents does not demonstrate that every relevant RFC, Internet-Draft, publication, or earlier contribution has been reviewed. This document discusses a voluntary approach to describing the scope and limits of related-work review in Internet-Draft contributions. It proposes a review-coverage statement, an illustrative record, and a process for correcting unsupported novelty claims. The approach does not replace IETF policies, create a new protocol, or certify priority, originality, or completeness.
